title: The seven wastes (TIMWOOD)
caption: Lean looks for seven kinds of waste. Overproduction is often called the worst, because it leads to the others: more inventory, more transport and more handling.
alt: Seven boxes: transport, inventory, motion, waiting, overproduction, over-processing, defects, each with what it means.
description: Overproduction: making more, or sooner, than needed.
Over-processing: doing more than the customer requires.
